Other keys carry the descriptive fields that individual clauses name (for example `names`, `op_index`, `status`); the contract states them per clause.

effect.description: Whether a mutating call had an effect (HP CA-5, ER-5).

result.title: EmptyValue
result.description: The empty `Result.value` `{}` of the handlers that return nothing (HP A2-5).

payload.title: WebhookPayload
payload.description: `Invoke.payload` of a `webhook` (HP A2-5, NT-7). `headers` is a list of `[name, value]` pairs as in A2-17.

result.title: WebhookResult
result.description: `Result.value` of a `webhook` (HP A2-5, NT-7): `status` is 100 to 599.

descriptor.title: EmptyDescriptor
